title: SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam
summary: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam The SEC charged eight Colorado-based entities, likely run from overseas, with taking more than $37 million from U.S. investors through fake advisers, fake crypto trading platforms and fake SEC certificates. This post SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
